correctness.rationale: The recurrence is forward-deterministic, with all RHS indices below n+m. The finite affine-shift identity for i=1..m implies k[n+N]=k[n]+n+N/2 at every n by algebraic invariance and induction. Then c[n]=2N*k[n]-n*n is N-periodic. If c has any positive period d, differences of integer k-shifts at adjacent n imply d/N integer, so N is least. The exact verifier actually executed and checked all 11,052 primitive triples of order at most 80 via two agreeing parameter enumerations, each m affine identities, and integral parity. Exact output VERIFY_OK; digest d95345c93044969f924f10fe37245a3424b72994f639951da7ff37365777058c. Finite parameter domain only.
